functions.name: init
functions.description: Restyles the Today Pane in open and future main windows if config.enabled is true and returns the available features.

functions.name: updateConfig
functions.description: Applies a new config to every open main window.

functions.name: getFeatures
functions.description: Returns whether the Today Pane look is available.

functions.name: getCalendarSettings
functions.description: Returns Thunderbird's own Today Pane settings: { todayPaneShown, weekNumbers, agendaDays }.

functions.name: setCalendarSetting
functions.description: Changes one of the settings getCalendarSettings returns.
